scope: Poissonnier 2026 experiment 1 DCM-control development estimation and matched cross-family re-evaluation only
honesty_note: The Poissonnier 2026 outcomes and prior H2/H3/H4 development results were already known when this measurement policy was frozen. The policy is based on newly audited raw coordinate and arena-bound fields from the pinned final-record supplement, not on choosing geometry values to improve an H5 result. No H5 runtime implementation or H5 parameter search had occurred when this policy was frozen.

coordinate_semantics.arena_frame: Each source row is translated to a local tracked-arena frame with x=0 at Xmin_Arena and y=0 at Ymin_Arena.
coordinate_semantics.first_track_position: Xstart/Ystart in the local tracked-arena frame. This is the first observed ant position and the start point used by the published Beeline measurement.
coordinate_semantics.entry_reference: The assay's central entry-hole/trail-crossing reference, represented as x=arena_width/2 and y=Y_Line-Ymin_Arena. In the 51 reconstructed DCM-control rows Y_Line is exactly the vertical midpoint.
coordinate_semantics.critical_separation: The measurement policy does not assert that first_track_position is the ant's remembered biological origin. H5 must separately freeze which permitted geometry reference its biology uses before H5 implementation.
coordinate_semantics.middle_zone: The article-defined central zone is 10 mm on each side of the central trail. For a sampled row its center_y is entry_reference_y_mm and its half-width is fixed at 10 mm.

why_nominal_geometry_is_not_used_for_fut.interpretation: The measured observation geometry differs materially from nominal A4 plus 0.5 mm center jitter, and prior no-H5 Chromium sensitivity tests showed that geometry alone can move the same observables used for development estimation.

loco_geometry_pool.fold_definition: Same six colony folds used by H2/H3/H4 development estimation.
loco_geometry_pool.training_pool_rule: For held-out colony c, the geometry pool contains every reconstructed DCM-control geometry row whose colony is not c.
loco_geometry_pool.colony_role: Colony identity is used only to exclude the held-out fold from the empirical geometry pool. It is not a biological model input and does not select colony-specific parameters.
loco_geometry_pool.pooled_descriptive_rule: A post-LOCO descriptive pooled run may use all 51 geometry rows, but it cannot alter any held-out decision or H5 mechanism choice.

geometry_sampler.row_order: ascending ant_id after applying the fold pool filter
geometry_sampler.selection_algorithm: Instantiate the existing deterministic RNG from streamSeed(trial_seed, rng_stream_name), consume exactly one uniform variate u, and select rows[min(n-1, floor(u*n))].
geometry_sampler.biology_rng_firewall: Geometry sampling must use its dedicated estimator/input stream and must not consume, shift, replace, or depend on any biological RNG stream.

simulation_application.when: Apply sampled measurement geometry to a cloned development-estimation bundle before constructing Simulation.
simulation_application.heading_policy: Unchanged by this measurement policy. Existing shared entry-heading assumptions or separately frozen nuisance treatment remain responsible for heading.
simulation_application.exit_edge_geometry: Classify first border contact against the sampled width and height.
simulation_application.beeline_geometry: Compute simulated Beeline from the actual simulated first observed position to the final observed position, matching the source Xstart/Ystart-to-Xlast/Ylast definition.
simulation_application.time_origin: The simulated observation begins at the reconstructed first-track position, preserving the Total_Frames/25 measurement window rather than adding an unobserved center-hole-to-first-track interval.

model_comparison_rule.H5_null_and_context: Must use identical fold geometry pools and identical trial-seed geometry draws.
model_comparison_rule.matched_H2_H3_H4: Any future cross-family comparison used for an H5 decision must re-evaluate the frozen comparator candidates under this same measurement geometry policy, with identical held-out rows, training-derived scorer scales, trial counts, evaluation seeds, and geometry draws wherever architectures permit.
model_comparison_rule.historical_reports: Existing H2/H3/H4 reports are preserved as historical results under their original nominal geometry assumptions and must not be relabeled as reconstructed-geometry results.

checks: Exact geometry-reference Git blob matches the frozen policy.
Exact derivation-script Git blob matches the frozen policy.
Source XLSX SHA256 matches the frozen policy.
Geometry reference has exactly 51 rows and six expected colonies.
Geometry rows contain exactly the allowed row fields and no treatment/outcome fields.
Each LOCO pool excludes every held-out-colony geometry row and includes all geometry rows from the five training colonies.
The same trial seed selects the same geometry row for short and long simulations.
The same trial seed selects the same geometry row for null and context simulations.
Matched comparator evaluation uses the same geometry row sequence.
Geometry RNG leaves all biological RNG stream states unchanged before biological execution.
Sampled width, height, first-track position, central-zone center, and zero position jitter are applied before Simulation construction.
Simulated Beeline starts at the sampled first-track position.
Canonical nominal apparatus and historical experiment files remain unchanged.
No Y-maze file, outcome, statistic, or simulation is accessed.

forbidden_changes_after_freeze: No inclusion of Path_length in the geometry reference or sampler.
No use of held-out-colony geometry in LOCO simulation generation.
No geometry candidate, fitted geometry parameter, or loss-based geometry selection.
No adding outcome fields to the geometry artifact.
No changing the geometry RNG stream, row ordering, or sampling rule after seeing H5 results.
No changing the 10 mm middle-zone half-width after seeing H5 results.
No automatic change to canonical apparatus, observation, experiment, or model files.

failure_and_bug_rule.scientific_failure: If H5 later fails under this frozen measurement policy, geometry may not be retuned to rescue H5. A different measurement policy would require genuinely new measurement evidence and a separately versioned analysis.
failure_and_bug_rule.implementation_bug: A demonstrated implementation defect invalidates affected runs. Fix the defect, document it, regression-test it, and rerun the frozen procedure unchanged. Poor model performance alone is not an implementation bug.
